items.title: Aussie Dollar Falls to Lowest Since July as RBA Hike Bets Fade
items.summary: The Australian dollar touched the lowest level since early July, extending its decline after domestic labor data pushed traders to scale back expectations of interest rate increases from the Reserve Bank of Australia.

items.title: Supreme Court rules against Yes Bank's write-off of Rs 8,415 crore AT1 bonds
items.summary: The Supreme Court confirmed the decision of the Bombay High Court regarding Yes Bank's AT1 bonds. This ruling impacts ₹8,415 crore in bonds written off during the bank's 2020 restructuring. The court noted that the administrator lacked the authority to write down these bonds. Bondholders had contested the write-off, citing mis-selling of the securities. Yes Bank is now obligated to repay the bonds along with accrued…

items.title: Fund Managers Quit to Trade Their Own Money in Taiwan Stock Boom
items.summary: The world’s biggest equity rally is creating an unusual bout of FOMO among Taiwan’s professional stock pickers.

items.title: MSCI Weighs Downgrade of Indonesia to Remove From Global Indexes
items.summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.

items.title: Gold Rallies With Treasuries as AI Selloff Boosts Haven Assets
items.summary: Gold rallied, bolstered by lower US Treasury yields as investors sought safety in bonds following an equity selloff.

items.title: Dollar Wraps Its Worst Day in Over a Month on AI Risk Concerns
items.summary: The dollar fell the most in more than a month, erasing gains fueled by hotter-than-expected inflation data.

items.title: India-US trade pact in last leg of legal drafting, says Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India is currently in the final stages of legal drafting for a trade agreement with the US, which is expected to be operational soon. The agreement, following sessions with US trade representatives, aims to ensure preferential access for Indian exporters. Indian officials hope for tariff stability and seek resolution on outstanding issues before the deal is signed.

items.title: India's September goods exports rise 23% as imports hit six-month low, narrowing trade deficit
items.summary: India's goods exports surged by 23% in September, totaling $44.4 billion, supported by significant gains in electronics, petroleum, and engineering goods. At the same time, imports rose by only 8%, leading to a reduced trade deficit of $30.21 billion. This export growth reflects a sustained positive trend in the second quarter of the current fiscal year. Notably, gold imports fell sharply by 81.27%, impacting…

items.title: US stocks: Dow, S&P 500 end higher as traders shift from AI to healthcare
items.summary: After a rocky start, the S&P 500 experienced a resurgence, largely spurred by investments in the healthcare and consumer segments. Investors seemed to distance themselves from technology stocks, anxious about mounting debts in the AI sector. Eli Lilly and UnitedHealth rose thanks to favorable evaluations from Deutsche Bank, whereas Broadcom and Nvidia struggled.

items.title: AI stock selloff eases as investors buy on dips amid falling bond yields
items.summary: A selloff in risky AI-linked stocks eased as buyers returned to technology amid falling bond yields. CoreWeave experienced significant stock declines and bond yield concerns raised worries about rising financing costs. Major AI laboratories like Anthropic and OpenAI reflected slowing growth, contributing to overall investor nervousness. Stock movements varied among leading companies as interest rates influenced…

items.title: Markets will push the US to act constructively: Nouriel Roubini
items.summary: Nouriel Roubini highlighted the significance of India's emerging economy during a recent event in Dubai. As the US seeks a constructive trade relationship with India, economic pressure is expected to guide policymaking. India is seen as vital due to its large domestic market and skilled workforce. The country needs to achieve near 9% growth to address job creation challenges amid AI advancements.

items.title: Canada’s Joly Threatens to Force Cleveland-Cliffs Asset Sale
items.summary: Canada’s industry minister said the government has the power to try to force Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. to sell its assets the country, escalating a dispute over job cuts at the company’s steel operations in Ontario.

items.title: Prosus Ventures leads $1.5 million funding in space startup Cosmochute
items.summary: Cosmochute is developing its LEAP lunar mobility platform to support payload transportation and deployment on the Moon, with funding aimed at accelerating development and hiring.

items.title: ADB, govt of Japan sign financing pact with AM Green Ammonia
items.summary: The deal includes a $100 million JICA-financed loan to help build a 1.1-million-tonne renewable-powered green ammonia facility in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh.

items.summary: French spirits maker Pernod Ricard, which on Thursday reported a 19 per cent sales growth in India for the September quarter, said its proposed initial public offering (IPO) in the country remains under discussion and is awaiting board approval. items.title: Anthropic's Q3 revenue jumps to $16.8 billion ahead of planned IPO
items.summary: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion, up nearly 12-fold from a year earlier, as the Claude maker prepares for an IPO amid slowing growth and concerns over AI valuations.

items.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
items.summary: India may raise fuel prices moderately in November, a brief window to do so before crucial state elections early next year, Oxford Economics said.

items.title: Put private sector at center of development agenda: Sitharaman to World Bank
items.summary: The finance minister urged the multilateral lender to prioritize job creation and productivity over total financing, calling for competitive pricing and local currency tools.

items.title: UCO Bank net profit rises 27% to ₹786 crore in July-September quarter
items.summary: Public sector UCO Bank on Thursday reported a 27 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 786 crore for the second quarter ended September 30. The Kolkata-based lender earned a net profit of Rs 620 crore in the same period last fiscal year. Total income increased to Rs 8,170 crore in the second quarter from Rs 7,421 crore a year ago, UCO Bank said in a regulatory filing. Interest income improved to Rs 7,286 crore in the…

items.title: India’s manufacturing growth opens new investment opportunities: Trifecta Capital co-founder Rahul Khanna
items.summary: India's manufacturing sector is expanding, which is leading to investment opportunities in various industries and defence. Trifecta Capital's co-founder highlighted the rise of trusted economies, with India being a key player. Companies are restructuring supply chains and leveraging technology to facilitate growth opportunities. Robotics developments in India are also helping to overcome data scarcity challenges in…

items.title: Construction-robot startup Origin raises $20 mn to automate interior work
items.summary: Accel and Zacua Ventures co-led the funding round, which will help Origin scale deployment of its OG-1 robot, expand its fleet and run customer pilots in overseas markets

items.title: US stocks: Nasdaq reports network disruption, US equities data feeds impacted
items.summary: Nasdaq is currently experiencing a network disruption at its Carteret facility, affecting US equities markets. A technical issue has caused data gaps within several multicast groups. Clients are urged to transition to backup feeds from Chicago to avoid impacts. Those facing data gaps should file recovery requests for missing information. Nasdaq is actively investigating the problem and has issued an apology for the…

items.title: Reliance Industries, BSE lead mutual fund buys in September, shows data
items.summary: Mutual funds invested nearly ₹6,000 crore in Reliance Industries in September, making it the most-bought stock, followed by BSE with inflows exceeding ₹5,500 crore.

items.title: S&P 500’s road to 8,000 grows tougher as yields rise, AI doubts mount; all eyes on quarterly earnings
items.summary: Analysts are doubtful about the S&P 500 crossing the 8,000 points mark despite strong earnings expectations. The rise in oil prices and bond yields has increased market uncertainty ahead of midterm elections. Major technology companies have reported mixed outcomes indicating potential risks for equity investments. Analysts suggest a growing divide in market performance among large and small companies.

items.title: RBI’s new forex reserve rules explained: FAQs on the 20% requirement, $2 million threshold and exemptions
items.summary: The RBI has clarified how its 20% Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve requirement applies to rupee-linked currency derivatives, including the $2 million threshold, exemptions, cancellations and rollovers.

items.title: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam sets up committee to explore cost cuts, team mergers and lower office lease expenses
items.summary: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam has formed a committee to explore cost cuts, including merging teams and reducing office lease expenses. The move comes as the airline's consolidated loss widened to ₹22,238.23 crore in 2025-26.

items.title: Water stress
items.summary: Reservoir storage in India dips below 70% national average; southern levels under 45%, but monsoon rains may improve outlook.

items.title: Tonbo Imaging IPO subscribed 4 times on Day 1, led by strong NII demand
items.summary: The defence electronics maker's ₹852 crore offer attracted strong demand across investor categories, while secondary share deals valued the Bengaluru-based firm at ₹4,000 crore
